newsitem.title: MEXICO: Accel Q2 net rises to 30.9 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Accel Q2 net rises to 30.9 mln pesos.

text.p: Mexican warehouser and manufacturer Accel said on Tuesday its net profit in the second quarter was 30.9 million pesos, up 28 percent from 24.2 million pesos a year ago.

It said sales in dollars rose 21.2 percent in the second quarter compared with the previous year, to $80.3 million from $66.3 million, while peso sales in constant terms rose just 4.1 percent because of a steady peso and 20.4 pct inflation.

Revenues from its warehousing and distribution division grew 72 percent because they included results from what was formerly Almacenadora Bancomer. Accel completed the purchase of Bancomer's warehousing units in the second quarter, in a deal that Bancomer said raised its capital assets by 256 million pesos.
Accel has two main divisions: manufacturing, via its Elamex division, and warehousing and distribution.
It also makes and sells clothes for the U.S. sportswear market via Tropical Sportswear International.
